'''Darth Hoth Agents of the Underworld''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 28 September 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 AOBS Hoth DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

another Underworld deck, this one using Black Sun.

== Strategy ==

First turn: activation-4. Use Ket Maliss(V) to deploy Coruscant: Docking Bay and take Greedo into hand. Use Location^3 to pull Tat:Jabba's Palace and use that to pull the Audience Chamber. Deploy Greedo to the docking bay and move Xizor to it and flip objective.

Opponent's turn: If opponent initiates a battle at the docking bay, lose Greedo (forfeit 6).

Second turn: activation-9. If you didn't lose Greedo, use him to pull Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? Ket Maliss (V) pulls Docking Bay 94, and Jabba's Palace pulls the Dungeon. Deploy whatever you can, and use Blaster Rack(V) to pull weapons.

Subsequent turns: activation-11. Get out All Wrapped Up quickly and start setting up Bounties. Only go to space if absolutely necessary, and even then, make sure to put all of the starships together. Use Bounties to retrieve force and initiate battles to retrieve with Scum. If the opponent is coming to ground, save the Audience Chamber text to pull the extra Xizor.

Card choices:

All characters-their are few enough characters that can be played in this deck, so most of them are there so I don't end up short on them.

Bad Feeling Have I-make Luke expensive to deploy.

Search and Destroy-get the opponent to come to ground if they're sitting in the air.

Defensive Fire(V)-get an extra shot in a battle.

Take Evasive Action(V)-good against speeders and Fallen Portal.

Mist Hunter(V)-great at reducing attrition, and chance of getting hit by weapons.

Hound's Tooth(V)-very strong if you occupy a lot of sites.

I think the rest is self-explanitory.

Thanks for looking, and, hopefully, reviewing.
